meta.name: overgrown_metro_hideout
meta.prompt: A high-tech apocalyptic hideout in the massively overgrown ruins of a metropolis.

programs.brief: A scavenged high-tech satellite communications dish and sensor spire erected atop reinforced concrete scaffolding, wired into the bunker below.

tokens.terrain: a sprawling grid of ruined skyscrapers heavily overgrown with dense jungle and massive root systems
tokens.fittings: blast_door on the bunker_complex; airlock_vestibule on the laboratory
tokens.infra: barricade_line across the ruined avenue leading to the hideout; surveillance_perimeter around the fortified shelter
tokens.icons: shattered skyscrapers smothered in vines and canopy trees; a heavily fortified high-tech shelter concealed within the concrete ruins; solar arrays and communication dishes hidden among overgrowth

root.label: The Overgrown Ruins of the Metropolis
